description: K breakdown for a FIGHT target decision in a local human-vs-human game. The fight score is now an itemised ledger (_score_fight_target books each bonus/penalty via _t_add/_t_mul, sum == score). Setup plays the AI's own suggested pile-ins and fighter selection (declining stratagem windows) until Trajann Valoris chooses a target; pressing K then shows a FIGHT card whose option details list 'Score made of:' parts (e.g. Damage it deals, Can wipe it out) instead of a single lumped number, and nothing is executed by the suggestion itself. The suggestion is requested via Main._on_ai_suggestion_pressed() (the K/button handler) because the modal Attack Assignment dialog holds keyboard focus at this point.
